purpose: Make one delivery attempt for the oldest Outbox Message of one Sender Installation: open its sealed bytes with the installation key, send exactly those uncompressed bytes to the Portal, and interpret the Portal's answer with ingest-protocol's response rules, removing the message locally only on a Delivery Receipt that echoes its exact installation, sequence, and SHA-256. Retryable failures, timeouts, and unknown or mismatched answers keep identical bytes for a later retry. A Delivery Block, or a head that cannot be opened or is not its own valid message, keeps the message intact, prevents later messages from being sent, and sets a persistent Operator-action-required head block with one local notification at its onset, which only the blocked head's receipt clears.

inputs.name: delivery_context
inputs.description: The installation's identity, installation key alias, and Portal URL from its enrollment offer, supplied by the shell from manage-sender-enrollment.

inputs.name: outbox_head
inputs.description: The installation's lowest-sequence Outbox Message row, read from stage-outbox-batch@1's Sender Outbox.

inputs.name: installation_key
inputs.description: The installation cipher that opens the sealed head with its Outbox AAD.

inputs.name: portal_transport
inputs.description: A seam that performs one HTTP request to the Portal and returns its response body, or reports that no response arrived.

inputs.name: portal_response
inputs.description: The Portal's response body to the attempt, or its absence after a timeout or network failure.

inputs.name: local_notifier
inputs.description: A seam that raises one health-data-free local notification naming a head block's failure.

inputs.name: sender_storage
inputs.description: The Sender's SQLite database: the Outbox rows this unit removes and this unit's head-block state, behind the 3ug seam and storage lane.

inputs.name: clock
inputs.description: The Sender wall clock for the head block's first and last seen times.

outputs.name: delivery_request
outputs.description: At most one POST of the head's exact uncompressed plaintext bytes to the Portal's /v1/outbox-messages route per attempt, with a JSON content type and a 60-second timeout.

outputs.name: attempt_outcome
outputs.description: Exactly one of empty, delivered, retryable, blocked, cipher-failed, or storage-failed, naming the head's sequence and failure where one applies.

outputs.name: receipt_bound_removal
outputs.description: Removal of exactly the head's Outbox row, only after a Delivery Receipt matching its installation, sequence, and SHA-256, leaving the Outbox high-water mark and every other row unchanged.

outputs.name: head_block_condition
outputs.description: A persistent, health-data-free head block for the installation (sequence, origin, failure, message SHA-256 when known, first and last seen times, and count) with one local notification at its onset, cleared only when the blocked head is removed by its receipt.

observable_effects.name: portal-delivery-request
observable_effects.description: Sends at most one HTTP request per attempt, carrying the head's exact uncompressed message bytes and nothing else.

observable_effects.name: local-notification
observable_effects.description: Raises one health-data-free local notification at the onset of each head block.

observable_effects.name: sender-storage-write
observable_effects.description: Applies this unit's Sender schema migration, removes a receipted head's Outbox row, and writes only its own head-block state.

owns: choosing the installation's oldest Outbox Message and making one attempt for it
the delivery request's method, path, content type, uncompressed body, and timeout, and the largest response body it reads
checking that the opened head is the canonical Outbox Message its row names
the persistent head block, its notification rule, and its clearing rule
does_not_own: wire schemas, message identity, the Delivery Receipt, retryable-failure, and Delivery Block vocabularies, and the interpretation of a response, which belong to ingest-protocol
the Sender Outbox's schema, sealing, AAD, sequences, and high-water mark, and the staging of each message kind, which belong to stage-outbox-batch, stage-sync-completion, and stage-sync-checkpoint
installation identity, the Portal URL, capability adoption and acknowledgement, key lifecycle, freezing an installation, drain, and reset, which belong to manage-sender-enrollment
acceptance, archival, and Delivery Blocks on the Portal, which belong to the accept-* units
the Portal route, decompression, request limits, and Authorized Ingress, which belong to the Portal ingress shell
the HTTP client, timeout enforcement, TLS, Tailscale reachability, the notification adapter, and when and how often to attempt delivery, which belong to the Sender shell enabling task
pausing collection under a head block, which belongs to coordinate-sender-sync
the end-to-end proof that Sender removal and Portal acknowledgement share one durability meaning, which belongs to receipt-bound-delivery
